text:
mai: opened a docs PR to update Dedicated provisioning examples + migration guide. Need review on autoscale policy examples and SLA wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287
sylvia: thanks! will look at autoscale policy YAML and confirm counts. quick q: do we want `reserved_capacity` or `pool_size` naming? repo uses `reserved` elsewhere.
kevin: prefer `pool_size` for clarity; `reserved_capacity` sounds like money. +1 to update migration notes about model pinning.
olivia: found a typo in SLA table — '99.9% avilability' -> availability. Also the isolation section needs a note about eviction vs preemption.
sylvia: added inline suggestion in PR for YAML snippet: include min_replicas and max_replicas and example with burst_policy.

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  burst_policy: 'aggressive'
```
kevin: for SDK snippet, we should show both Python and JS. Proposed Python snippet:

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
resp = client.create_pool(name='prod-eu', pool_size=4, model='gpt-lite-v1')
print(resp)
```
mai: nice, but create_pool is sync; add await in example? Python SDK is sync currently.
kevin: oh right — my bad. Use `.create_pool_sync`? hmm. @dev-docs-bot do we have canonical SDK examples file?
dev-docs-bot: docs/snippets/dedicated_sdk_examples.md was last updated 2025-11-02 by olivia.
olivia: I updated that file last month, but the JS example is out of date. I'll push a small PR after this.
ricardo: small suggestion for SLA wording: change 'SLA applies to p99 latency' -> 'SLA covers uptime and p95 latency for dedicated pools; p99 is advisory'.
mai: agree. Let's avoid promising p99 for single-tenant. I'll add suggested phrasing.
sylvia: also add a migration checklist for customers moving from hosted->dedicated: steps include model pinning, traffic split, prewarm pool, KMS key rotation. I added a bullet list in PR.
kevin: I left a nit on link to terraform module (broken anchor). Update to https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules/tree/main/dedicated#provisioning
mai: thanks. I'll push fix and merge once approvals from @sylvia and @olivia.
olivia: approved + :thumbsup:
sylvia: approved
mai: merging in 10m unless new concerns.
dev-docs-bot: PR merged by mai at 1769123515
